title: Filing Lead and the Early Retirement Discount Rate — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Member Terms
content:
# Filing Lead and the Early Retirement Discount Rate

**Member terms, Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** For distribution-margin rows retired under an approved discounted early retirement, the early discount rate is moved by the request's filing lead — the calendar days from the request's submitted date to its board approval date:

- a lead of at least **60** calendar days adds **-0.25** percentage points to the rate (lowering it by a quarter point);
- a lead of fewer than **21** calendar days adds **0.5** percentage points to the rate;
- any other lead — 21 to 59 calendar days — leaves the rate unchanged.

The two dates are those on the approved discounted early retirement request: the date it was submitted and the date of the board meeting that approved it.

## Lead and adjustment

| Filing lead (calendar days) | Change to the early discount rate |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | -0.25 points |
| 21 to 59 | none |
| 20 or fewer | 0.5 points added |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Submitted | Board approval | Lead | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 18 | November 17 | 60 days | -0.25 points |
| September 19 | November 17 | 59 days | none |
| October 27 | November 17 | 21 days | none |
| October 28 | November 17 | 20 days | 0.5 points added |

**Worked figure (hypothetical rate).** On a rate of 7.0 percent, a 64-day lead gives 6.75 percent; a 12-day lead gives 7.5 percent; a 40-day lead leaves 7.0 percent. The change is in percentage points added to the rate, never a percent of the rate.
